_readme: Edit this file to configure Baxter. Every setting is optional. See the README.
_integrations_note: This file (preferences.json) is the global, public config — the defaults every clone gets, safe to commit and publish. preferences.local.json is private: if it exists, its integrations settings are used instead of what's below, key by key. It is gitignored and never published — create it only if you want real integration settings (e.g. your own GitHub repo, your own tracker workspace) without publishing them.
